name: S6: the automatic retry chain is bounded, and only an explicit retry spends a new attempt
clause: A failed automatic compaction remains durably retry-pending before its bounded retry.
whyDirect: The named production service test invokes the real compaction service with a failing summarizer and asserts the persisted-attempt outcome returned by the first automatic call.

name: S6: the automatic retry chain is bounded, and only an explicit retry spends a new attempt
expression: assert.equal(second.task?.id, first.task?.id, 'the retry resumes the existing attempt');
clause: The automatic retry resumes the same durable compaction task.
whyDirect: The service test compares the second attempt's durable task ID with the first task ID, proving retry recovery does not create an unrelated compaction chain.

name: S6: the automatic retry chain is bounded, and only an explicit retry spends a new attempt
clause: The automatic retry chain records exhaustion instead of scheduling indefinitely.
whyDirect: The production service test observes the stable exhausted-retry failure code after the permitted automatic retry.

name: S6: the automatic retry chain is bounded, and only an explicit retry spends a new attempt
expression: assert.equal(calls, 2, 'one initial attempt plus exactly one automatic retry');
clause: At most one automatic retry is spent for one failed source chain.
whyDirect: The test counts actual summarizer invocations and directly asserts exactly the initial invocation plus one automatic retry.

name: S6: the automatic retry chain is bounded, and only an explicit retry spends a new attempt
expression: assert.equal(calls, 2, 'a spent chain must not start a new Provider call');
clause: An exhausted automatic chain does not schedule another Provider call on the next evaluation.
whyDirect: The test invokes the service a third time and observes that the real summarizer call count remains two.

name: S6: the automatic retry chain is bounded, and only an explicit retry spends a new attempt
expression: assert.notEqual(explicit.task?.id, first.task?.id, 'an explicit retry starts its own attempt');
clause: A new attempt after automatic exhaustion requires an explicit retry request.
whyDirect: The service test supplies resume=explicit and directly verifies that only that explicit path starts a new durable attempt.
